title: School Procedures for Students Involved in Police Investigations
what_it_is: School Procedures for Students Involved in Police Investigations

sections.label: Police interviewing students in schools
sections.summary: A question asks the Acting Minister for Education (Schools) about schools' procedures when Police interview a student and later take the student to a Police station.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Schools) what are the schools' procedures when the Police go to a school to interview a student in relation to a crime and later decide to bring the student to the Police station for further questioning.
